description: Fetch the full rendered content and metadata of any single GOV.UK page from its base_path — guidance, a policy paper, an organisation page, a departmental manual or one section of one. Returns title, description, body, publication and last-updated timestamps, and the page's links. Use gov_uk_search or hmrc_manual_search first when you do not already know the base_path.
name: content

outputSchema.description: Content retrieved from GOV.UK API for a given base_path

title: Content
